trust_decision.summary: Each provider's suggestions() decides whether the provider-supplied email is trusted (provideTrustedEmail, which lets Flarum core match/log into an existing account by email) or only suggested; at the pinned commit it is trusted unconditionally regardless of the provider's verified flag.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names the Discord provider; its suggestions() calls provideTrustedEmail unconditionally.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /auth/{provider} with provider=discord (OAuth callback) via AuthController::setSuggestions

fix_sites.module_kind: provider adapter (sibling); verified flag read through in-repo custom resource owner

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All four fix sites are sibling provider classes in src/Providers/; Facebook/GitHub only got docblocks (fix.diff:63-65, fix.diff:85-87).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 email-sync route: it only rewrites the email of an account already linked to that provider identity, on login rather than registration, so a solver can argue it is not 'account takeover via registration trust' and is an admin-enabled convenience feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Users whose provider email IS verified must still get provideTrustedEmail (auto-confirmed/matched), and unverified users must still be able to register with the email pre-filled via suggestEmail rather than being rejected; GitHub's verified-only API fallback must keep working.

O6_input_shapes: Discord: boolean 'verified' key in raw payload, absent treated as unverified (fix.diff:31-37)
GitLab: 'confirmed_at' timestamp, empty/null treated as unverified (fix.diff:114-120)
LinkedIn: 'email_verified' attribute via custom resource owner getAttribute (fix.diff:187-191)

O7_producer.where: src/Providers/Custom/LinkedIn/Provider/LinkedInResourceOwner.php:59-62 (getAttribute over raw response); other providers' owners are vendor libraries

O8_uncovered_routes.route: On every OAuth login, UpdateEmailFromProvider dispatches CheckAndUpdateUserEmail, which changes the linked user's email to the provider email with no verified-flag check (setting defaults to on).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only touches the already-linked account's own email on login, not registration/account matching; framed as a sync feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/Listeners + src/Jobs/CheckAndUpdateUserEmail.php:70-79, two files away from src/Providers; default on at extend.php:61

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Twitter (OAuth1, separate controller) calls provideTrustedEmail unconditionally; the league/oauth1 User object exposes no verified flag.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Twitter's API only returns verified emails, separate OAuth1 controller, and the maintainers did not touch it; likely genuinely safe.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an isEmailVerified()-style accessor whose key lookup or dot-notation (getValueByKey) diverges from the field the check reads
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The in-repo resource owner already maps raw keys with dot notation; a maintainer adding a verified accessor here is natural and it is a mapper the provider check calls.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the email-sync job could carry a provider 'verified' value through its serialized queue payload that is dropped/defaulted on reload
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The job is ShouldQueue + SerializesModels (src/Jobs/CheckAndUpdateUserEmail.php:22-26); adding a verified flag to its constructor is the obvious fix and a serialization boundary.

O9_family: CWE-345 insufficient verification of data authenticity: trusting an unverified identity attribute (email) from an OAuth provider, enabling account linking/takeover

O10_build.toolchain: composer; flarum/core ^1.8.1, fof/extend, league oauth2 clients; phpunit via flarum/testing
O10_build.project_tests: tests/integration/AuthenticationFlowTest.php:60 (one OAuth login test); composer.json:97-104 test scripts. No tests for email trust per provider; fix adds none.

j.j_sites_touched: src/Providers/Discord.php, src/Providers/GitLab.php, src/Providers/Google.php, src/Providers/LinkedIn.php (plus docblock-only src/Providers/Facebook.php, src/Providers/GitHub.php)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Gate provideTrustedEmail on the 'verified' flag in Discord.php only, or throw on unverified email instead of falling back to suggestEmail.

out_of_scope_notes: Account matching by trusted email happens in flarum/core Forum\Auth\ResponseFactory (vendor, not in this repo).
